airports.name: Louisville–Standiford Field (1986)
airports.historical_location_note: Commercial flights moved from Bowman Field to Standiford Field in 1947. A new landside terminal opened in 1985; the airside terminal opened in 1989 and the International name dates to 1995. Modern coordinates provide an approximate airport-area marker only: later runway reconstruction means this is not a precise 1986 runway, gate or aircraft position.

coordinate_kind: Modern OurAirports coordinate used as approximate marker for the independently reviewed historical airport site.
historical_scope: Standiford Field, not Bowman Field. Present-day runway arrangement and the later International/Muhammad Ali names are not projected back into 1986.
